journeys.title: Join, practise, return and reach billing
journeys.uniqueRisk: Actual deployed signup, owner-bound save/provider response and authenticated return cannot be established by pure functions.
journeys.isolation: Expiry is terminal before verified deletion; no production expiry mutation or payment implied.
journeys.passEvidence: Bound saved row and coaching; exact rendered deep link; mic off; approved expiry denial and deletion readback.

journeys.title: Full and partial Focus
journeys.uniqueRisk: Streaming recognition, rendered point evidence and durable take identity can disagree across real boundaries.
journeys.isolation: Independent full/partial fixtures; reset target state; feedback recovery prerequisite.
journeys.passEvidence: Known matched/unmatched points agree live, saved and reopened; no invented evidence.

journeys.title: Leave during cold Start
journeys.uniqueRisk: Actual browser teardown during model and mic acquisition.
journeys.isolation: Own cold context; prove pending state before navigation.
journeys.passEvidence: No mic or unintended session; no automatic resume; deliberate recovery saves.

journeys.title: Save across request and response loss
journeys.uniqueRisk: Request never committed and committed response lost have different network/database behavior.
journeys.isolation: Separate fault legs; reset interceptors, drafts and leases.
journeys.passEvidence: Exact fault exercised; attempt counts; one durable save; independent next take.

journeys.title: Report with and without context
journeys.uniqueRisk: Receiving-store acknowledgment and persisted association can diverge from UI.
journeys.isolation: Fence and recovery required; virgin-account interpretation requires separate account leg.
journeys.passEvidence: Correct older IDs or null associations; receiving proof; bounded writes; verified recovery.

journeys.title: Navigate and close a recording tab
journeys.uniqueRisk: Document destruction differs from route navigation and may lose callbacks.
journeys.isolation: Independent surviving observer; per-leg document identity and finalization.
journeys.passEvidence: Recording-before-leave; release and no auto-resume; next-take isolation; source provenance.

journeys.title: Competing contexts and takeover
journeys.uniqueRisk: Independent contexts race against deployed authority.
journeys.isolation: Separate contexts; preserve both take identities.
journeys.passEvidence: Refusal before model work; old owner fenced; no cross-take mutation.

journeys.title: Microphone denial and recovery
journeys.uniqueRisk: Actual browser permission boundary cannot be proven by mocked errors.
journeys.isolation: File-level deny launch; fresh-browser recovery is not same-context permission proof.
journeys.passEvidence: Press-bound denial; no recording; explicit recovery saves and reopens.

journeys.title: Model asset request failure
journeys.uniqueRisk: Real cold asset path is absent from mocked E2E build.
journeys.isolation: Fresh cold context; actual own-origin asset refusal.
journeys.passEvidence: Fault observed; truthful Retry; no fallback; restored request saves and reopens.

journeys.title: Offline during model transfer
journeys.uniqueRisk: Partial real transfer and interruption differ from initial request rejection.
journeys.isolation: Go offline only after received bytes; no bytes means HOLD.
journeys.passEvidence: Transfer bytes observed; truthful failure; reconnect and retry saves and reopens.
